title: Windows Setup - Direct UEFI/BIOS Access
applies_to: Windows 10/11 Setup or out-of-box experience (OOBE) on a UEFI-equipped PC when Settings and the normal Windows desktop are not accessible; Dell Pro Micro QCM1250 included
preconditions: A technician is physically at the intended PC and has permission to restart it
Windows Setup/OOBE is displayed, and any unsaved setup state has been acknowledged
Command Prompt can be opened with Shift+F10 (or Shift+Fn+F10 if the keyboard requires Fn)
The technician confirms the next boot should enter UEFI firmware rather than continue Windows Setup
forbidden_use: Do not run this as a Windows installation bypass, password reset, or firmware-setting change
Do not combine this command with registry setup-completion hotfixes; these are separate failure modes
Do not execute remotely, without technician confirmation, or against a different host
Do not assume the firmware redirect is supported in Windows PE/disabled diagnostic-prompt environments
scan_instructions: At Windows Setup/OOBE on the target, press Shift+F10; try Shift+Fn+F10 if needed
Confirm the opened window is Command Prompt on the intended PC
Scan the CMD payload from the SysAdminSuite helper or type it exactly
Press Enter if the scanner did not send Enter; the device restarts immediately
Confirm that UEFI/BIOS Setup appears; if unavailable or command fails, restart and tap F2 at the Dell logo (F12 can offer BIOS Setup on some Dell models)
expected_result: On a supported Windows/UEFI installation, the next restart enters firmware settings. Entering and changing settings remain separate technician decisions. Dell QCM1250 fallback: F2 immediately at startup.
rollback_note: No firmware settings are changed by this command. The restart itself is immediate and cannot be undone; if redirect is unsupported, use the F2 hardware method.
evidence_to_capture: device manufacturer and model (no asset/serial identifier in public Git)
whether firmware redirect was accepted or returned an error
BIOS/UEFI menu observed versus hardware-key fallback
date, technician initials and private ticket closure reference (stored outside Git)
